answer_1.quote: Text style transfer is a task that changes the style of input sentences while preserving their styleindependent content. Due to its wide applications... it has become a research hotspot in natural language generation in recent years.
models: Attentional Seq2seq with neural style component

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the quality of output sentences in terms of transfer accuracy and content preservation. Following previous work, we use the pre-trained style classifier to calculate the transfer accuracy of output sentences... Moreover, we compute the BLEU scores... Finally, we report the geometric mean and harmonic mean of these metrics.

answer_4.quote: We invite 3 annotators with linguistic background to evaluate the output sentences... the annotators are required to score each aspect of sentences from 1 to 5.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators scored each sentence on transfer accuracy (Acc), content preservation (Con), and fluency (Flu) on a scale of 1 to 5.
